name: Steal The Brainrot Base🧠
desc:
Welcome to Steal The Brainrot Base🧠

1. Sneak into the enemy base and snatch a Brainrot! 🤫

2. Outrun the raging Brainrot chasing you! 🏃‍♂️💨

3. Bring them back to your base to stack that cash! 💵

🧠 Your Brainrot earn cash OFFLINE! 💤 

Having fun? 👍 Like the game and invite your friends to play! 😄
